title: Electrolyser buying in India 2026
subtitle: what 62 buyers told us
summary: We asked 62 people who buy or specify electrolysers at Indian companies, PSUs and labs how they choose a supplier, what they check before ordering and what slows them down.
findings: Lead time, not price, was the most common reason for choosing a supplier.
7 in 10 want a performance guarantee in kWh/kg written into the contract.
Fewer than a third checked stack degradation data before ordering.
Most plan a first order under 5 MW before committing to larger plants.
contents: The specs that decide a purchase
writtenBy: The H2 India research desk. Fieldwork from 1 Sep to 10 Oct 2026; 62 complete responses. Method notes are in the report.
